import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import warnings
import gc

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data from correct path
input_dir = "./input"
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Separate features and target
y = train_df["target"]
X_train = train_df.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1).copy()

# Encode categorical column - f_27 is the only object type column
X_train["f_27"] = X_train["f_27"].astype("category").cat.codes

# Create interaction features (feature engineering for interactions mentioned in competition)
# Select a subset of key features to create interactions (memory efficiency)
continuous_features = [
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]
int_features = [
    "f_07",
    "f_08",
    "f_09",
    "f_10",
    "f_11",
    "f_12",
    "f_13",
    "f_14",
    "f_15",
    "f_16",
    "f_17",
    "f_18",
]

# Create meaningful interaction features
interaction_features = []
for cf in continuous_features[:4]:  # Use first 4 continuous features
    for ife in int_features[:4]:  # Use first 4 integer features
        interaction = f"{cf}_{ife}"
        X_train[interaction] = X_train[cf] * X_train[ife]
        interaction_features.append(interaction)

print(f"Number of interaction features added: {len(interaction_features)}")

# Create train/validation split (80/20) - stratified
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

print(f"Training set: {X_train_split.shape}")
print(f"Validation set: {X_val_split.shape}")

# Prepare test features with same interactions
test_ids = test_df["id"]
X_test = test_df.drop(["id"], axis=1).copy()
X_test["f_27"] = X_test["f_27"].astype("category").cat.codes

# Create same interactions for test set
for cf in continuous_features[:4]:
    for ife in int_features[:4]:
        interaction = f"{cf}_{ife}"
        X_test[interaction] = X_test[cf] * X_test[ife]

# Define all feature columns
feature_columns = X_train_split.columns.tolist()

print(f"Total features: {len(feature_columns)}")
print(f"Feature columns (sample): {feature_columns[:10]}")

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_split, label=y_train, feature_name=feature_columns)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_split, label=y_val, reference=train_data, feature_name=feature_columns
)

# Train model with optimized hyperparameters for speed
model = lgb.train(
    params={
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 63,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "feature_fraction": 0.95,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.9,
        "bagging_freq": 10,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 100,
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "n_jobs": -1,
    },
    train_set=train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Calculate validation AUC-ROC on hold-out set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val_split, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file matching sample format
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_predictions})

# Ensure directory exists and save
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")

# Verify submission file
print(f"\nSubmission file verification:")
print(f"  - Rows: {len(submission)}")
print(f"  - Columns: {list(submission.columns)}")
print(f"  - ID range: {submission['id'].min()} - {submission['id'].max()}")
print(
    f"  - Target range (probabilities): {submission['target'].min():.4f} - {submission['target'].max():.4f}"
)
